Name: Mayor's Town
Author: ThatKingKai
Description:
[center]I'm sorry I have taken a step back from modding, I have not been intentionally ignoring everyone! I have been devoting all of my spare time to developing my own game! 

Obviously, my game has no relevance to this mod, but nevertheless I feel I should at least showcase why I have been absent for so long. 

Introducing; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458750/Wardens_of_Wen/]Wardens of Wen, available on Steam now[/url]!

Once my game has had it's full release and I have less personal pressure I plan to get back to modding once again! Thank you for your interest in my mod, and for your patience![/center]
[center][/center]
[center][url=https://discord.gg/wNkKJES6QY]Come join the Wardens Discord![/url]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]🌆 Mayor's Town - A Stardew Valley Expansion Mod[/size]
[size=4][i]Requirements: SpaceCore, ContentPatcher, Central Station
[/i][/size][/b][/center]


[i]Mayor's Town[/i] is a large-scale Stardew Valley mod that unlocks a new frontier: building and managing an entire town from the ground up. Early in the first summer, the player is entrusted by Mayor Lewis to lead the development of a brand-new settlement just outside of Pelican Town.

[center][youtube]0CsxdIKV-F8[/youtube]

[url=https://discord.gg/JR7mCPd58w]
[/url][b][size=6][url=https://discord.gg/XRnuHY5uuS][size=6]Hub Discord for all my mods![/size][/url][/size][/b]
﻿[/center]

[center][b][size=4]🧱 Core Concept[/size][/b][/center]


On the fifth day of the first summer, the player is invited to purchase a massive plot of land newly cleared just down the highway. This land becomes the foundation for a fully player-managed town, where you'll:

[list]
[*]Construct buildings using prefabs[/*]
[*]Recruit and manage a growing population of villagers[/*]
[*]Assign jobs and automate production chains[/*]
[*]Tend to the town’s needs such as food, medicine, recreation, and defense[/*]
[*]Create a thriving new community off the beaten path[/*]
[/list]



[center][b][size=4]🗺️ Systems Overview[/size][/b][/center]


[b]✅ Requirements and Unlock Conditions[/b]
[list]
[*]Begins on Summer 5 of Year 1[/*]
[*]50,000g to purchase the new land[/*]
[*]Town becomes accessible via Central Station's bus network after a 7-day cleanup phase; Lewis mails you when the route opens and the stop is permanently unlocked[/*]
[/list]

[center][b][size=4]🏗️ Systems to Be Implemented[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]Disease & Wound System (healing via Clinic)[/*]
[*]Happiness System (impacted by food, recreation, medicine, safety, etc.)[/*]
[*]Guard Patrol System (guards protect town and escort miners)[/*]
[/list]



[center][b][size=4]🏘️ Gameplay Loop[/size][/b][/center]


[list=1]
[*]Purchase the land after meeting requirements[/*]
[*]Construct the Town Hall, which spawns your first villagers[/*]
[*]Build housing and functional buildings (Farms, Clinic, Pub, etc.)[/*]
[*]Assign villagers to jobs and watch them autonomously maintain the town[/*]
[*]Expand production, manage resource chains, maintain happiness and safety[/*]
[*]Create a thriving secondary economy that operates alongside your farm[/*]
[/list]



[center][b][size=4]🧑‍🌾 Villager Roles and Automation[/size][/b][/center]


Each building type corresponds to a job role. Once assigned, villagers will automatically perform duties related to their building:

[list]
[*][b]Water Runners[/b]: Will provide water from a Well for up to 10 Villagers.[/*]
[*][b]Farmers[/b]: Tend to Greenhouses.[/*]
[*][b]Doctors[/b]: Heal wounds and recover villager health.[/*]
[/list]



[center][b][size=4]🏛️ Initial Building Types[/size][/b][/center]




[b]Town Hall [/b]- [i]must be built first. Only one can be built and it spawns 2–3 villagers on completion.[/i]
[b]Cabins[/b] - [i]Villagers auto-assign homes; empty cabins may attract new residents overnight.[/i]
[b]Villager Greenhouse[/b] - [i]Produces Food for the Villagers - can set 4 different crops which yield different values - requires 10 seeds (Potato, Wheat, Melon, Corn)
[/i][b]Clinic[/b] - Assigns a Villager to become a Doctor, will heal injured Villagers.
[b]Well [/b]- [i]Produces Water for the Villagers (Up to 10 per Well)[/i]




[center][b][size=4]📜 Story & Progression[/size][/b][/center]

On Summer 5 of your first year, Mayor Lewis personally visits your farm to share exciting news:

[i]“A massive stretch of land has just opened up down the highway. I think you're the perfect person to make something great out of it—when you're ready, come speak with me.”[/i]

[b]Progression[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Meet Mayor Lewis: He stops by the farm at dawn to propose purchasing the new land.[/*]
[*]Purchase the Land: Sign the deed and wait 7 in-game days as it’s cleared (construction noises each night).[/*]
[*]Unlock Access: After 7 days, the bus stop permanently appears and Mayor Lewis mails you that the bus can now take you to your new town.[/*]
[*]Name Your Town: Upon first arrival, you're prompted to name your settlement.[/*]
[*]Meet the Former Owner: A short tutorial begins explaining prefab buildings and villager management.[/*]
[*]Return to Mayor Lewis: He offers to act as your "contractor," managing construction like Robin does on the farm.[/*]
[*]Build the Town Hall: This kicks off your town’s expansion and unlocks all other buildings.[/*]
[*]Build Cabins!: Your Villagers need Cabins! One Cabin per Villager! They will move-in automatically! If you have more Cabins than you need, more Villagers may show up![/*]
[*]Build a Greenhouse!: The Villagers need Food! Build a Greenhouse, then bring seeds with you to select from the list of available Crops - each crop supply a different amount of Villagers![/*]
[*]Build a Well!: Villagers need water as well, a single Well will supply up to 10 Villagers!
[/*]
[*]Build a Clinic!: Villagers will often get injured when working, more often if their stats are on the lower side. The Doc will get em patched right up!


[/*]
[/list]

[size=6][b][i][u]Please keep in mind this is a mod is in a VERY early stage. This is to gauge interest and collaborate on bugs, issues, ideas - etc.[/u][/i][/b][/size]
